functions.purpose: Chunked immutable recovery storage and compact invoice manifest
At most ten line creates/deletes per batch; read-only final verification
One payment per batch, nested accounting continuation

storage.integrity: SHA-256 and invoice/operation/part membership verified on read
storage.retention: Parts retained as recovery/audit data. Not scheduled work; existing Pending/Retry scheduler does not process them.

widget: Sets batch=true, continues pending responses sequentially with the same operation key, reports stage/detail, blocks duplicate saves, retains local request and offers Resume correction after interruption.
compatibility: Legacy inline journals and small requests without batch continue to work. Large plans automatically use batching; older widgets require manual Resume until upgraded. No new public authentication required.
validation: Functions compiled in Zoho; published source read back. Zoho formatter removed redundant boolean parentheses in two helpers; read-back versions tested locally.
Browser tested sequential continuation, disabled save/close during batches, lost connection and reopening/resuming.
Large-plan, lost-response, missing/tampered-part, concurrent edit, bounded create/delete and final-verification tests passed with mocked CRM. No real invoices/payments altered for tests.
remaining_limits: Planning and full graph validation still read the complete related graph; existing query/API limits apply. Mutation batching addresses execution work and the 30000-character journal failure, not unlimited CRM graph size. Plans above 2 million characters are rejected before invoice changes.
remaining: Upload widget and retry the affected correction. No ZIP generated.
